definitions.explanation: A Japanese hot pot dish featuring thinly sliced beef simmered in a sweet soy sauce broth (warishita) along with vegetables, tofu, and noodles. Pieces are typically dipped in beaten raw egg before eating.

examples.japanese: {今夜|こんや}はすき{焼|や}きにしよう。
すき{焼|や}きの{肉|にく}を{溶|と}き{卵|たまご}につけて{食|た}べる。
examples.english: You dip the sukiyaki meat in beaten egg and eat it.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}になると{家族|かぞく}みんなで{鍋|なべ}を{囲|かこ}んですき{焼|や}きを{食|た}べるのが{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: In winter, I look forward to the whole family gathering around the pot for sukiyaki.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTES: A popular winter dish and a celebratory meal. The {関東|かんとう} style uses a pre-mixed sauce called {割|わ}り{下|した} (warishita), while the {関西|かんさい} style cooks the meat first by searing it with sugar and soy sauce directly in the pan.

Common ingredients include {牛肉|ぎゅうにく} (beef), {豆腐|とうふ} (tofu), {白菜|はくさい} (napa cabbage), {長|なが}ネギ (green onion), しらたき (shirataki noodles), and {春菊|しゅんぎく} (garland chrysanthemum).
